author: Sakura Stan
review_text: Chin Chin Eating House at 19 Purvis Street is a classic Hainanese restaurant that has stood the test of time since the 1930s. Known for its authentic steamed chicken rice, the eatery gained extra fame after JJ Lin visited and declared it his must-eat spot in Singapore. The chicken is silky and tender, paired perfectly with fragrant rice infused with chicken stock and ginger. The accompanying chilli sauce adds just the right amount of heat. The restaurant’s old-school charm — marble tables, ceiling fans, and nostalgic vibes — offers a glimpse into Singapore’s dining heritage. Besides chicken rice, dishes like Hainanese pork chop and curry fish head are also crowd favourites. Service is brisk and portions generous, though the place can get crowded, especially after JJ Lin’s endorsement. While not fancy, Chin Chin delivers honest, comforting food that embodies the true taste of traditional Hainanese cooking. For fans of JJ Lin or anyone seeking an authentic local experience, it’s a worthwhile stop for a satisfying, old-fashioned meal in the heart of Bugis.

author: Kei Fung Lee
review_text: We (2 adults and 2 boys, 8 and 5 year’s old) enjoyed the dinner around 19:50, weekday. We ordered half chicken, two rice, one mixed vegetables, one standard fried rice and one beverage. The price is reasonable. Staffs are helpful and lovely.

author: Zhang Clinton
review_text:
Let me just say this in Chinese : 3.7分，天理難容！
This is a restaurant that conquers you with the taste! We ordered half of a chicken, prawn roll and fried salted egg shrimp ball,they all taste like heaven and especially the shrimp ball, less starch and juicy crispy shrimp, don’t need to tell you that’s hard to find!

Worth a shot, will come back again.
I don’t think the waiters and boss are rude, they are just tired.

author: Jacelyn Phang
review_text:
There was a snaking queue during dinner time (Friday 7plus) but I was seated inside the eatery very quickly. Managed to get the last order for the chicken (will recommend to go before 8pm cos the chicken was sold out at that time).

Service was good and prompt !!
Had a $15 chicken, 2 plates of rice, a sambal French beans and a salted veg tofu soup for 2 pax. Food came in adequate portion and was tasty.

I did feel that my white chicken was a bit too cold thou. 🥶 the soup has a comforting homely style with a lot of ingredients!! 👍🏻

author: Vincent Ku
review_text: The Hainan chicken is very nice. Other dishes so so. Only accept cash so see local people have to go out to find ATM. Don't expect much service. It's a very local neighborhood restaurant only.

author: E Ang
review_text: An old fashioned eating outlet resemblance of a traditional coffee shop. The main food item served is chicken rice which is not bad and is different from the normal boils type of cooking for the chicken. The meat is not so fatty but yet is tender and chewy. Is nice and tasty. The veggie is cooked Hainanese style with lots of dried shrimp and its favors is too strong and not too my liking. Otherwise the chicken and rice is definitely good and is recommended .

author: Sasa Swift
review_text:
Food quality dropped so much. Rice was not the high quality jasmine rice and no fragrance of authentic Hainanese Rice. Chillies and ginger was good. Chicken was tender and juicy but lack of the depth of taste. Worse is the fried bitter gourd with egg, it served as mixed veggies, watery veggies with weird combinations, onions, butter gourd, egg and lettuce ! Who eat like that? the soup is free but .. not worth to mention of it:
Old school restaurant that has lost its charm

author: Yve
review_text: You know the food is good when the boss dare to scold customers.

author: He Lyu
review_text: One of the best local restaurant have ever been i think their carry cabbage and also their chicken is so good and chicken is very tender and juicy and they really love the source to it

author: denise phang
review_text: Nice chicken rice, prawns! Do not go with very hungry stomach as there will be people queue up

author: Ming Bin Lee
review_text:
Super damn poor services especially the lady boss not friendly at all
Food just so so
If you order not much, she will show face not welcoming you
Won’t be visiting next time!

author: Hoe Gee
review_text:
The auntie taking the order was trying to hard to be nice and talking too much
Alr ordered Hainan pork rice and she has forgotten, and asked for further order. Then later she recalled i already mentioned it.
3 cups of kopi, 2x kopi O siew dai and 1x kopi C kosong all wrong. It served 2x Kosong O and 1x C siew dai.
After the meal, 2x persons not happy with the drinks,  just me OK with or without sugar.
Auntie has written down the order which is good, but her mind processor just intended to talk instead.
The food order accuracy is absolutely a priority, no 2x ways about it.
If the food all messed up, then the service means nothing.

author: Paul Y
review_text:
The owner of this restaurant was cocky and rude.  A guy selling Hainanese chicken rice who couldn’t even say a word in Hainanese.
When I courteously and gently asked where we could get the chicken soup like last time, after we had been waiting for more than 10 mins when all dishes were served, thinking it could’ve been a self service; instead of addressing our need, he turned around, out of nowhere accused us to his team that we were impatient.

If this owner runs a business of this size with reasonable quality of food, he should have known how to treat his clients well.  Shame on this owner !

author: Natsuki Chen (AsiaDream)
review_text:
This is a popular restaurant with long queues, so you'll likely have to wait a while.

The seating area is crowded and noisy, giving it a distinctly old Singaporean feel.

The food is typical of many restaurants; the flavors are average, tasty but nothing particularly amazing.

author: Jayden Han
review_text: This restaurant’s food is pretty good, but the atmosphere is a bit loud and unclean

author: PH Mon
review_text: The white chicken meat and pork chop is normal. The 铁板豆腐 came with a lot of dishes even for "small" size and is definitely worth trying.

author: Cindy
review_text: Food was way better last time dunno what happened……. Service sucks! Auntie just starts cleaning in front of you and the soup spilled on to me!

author: Elsie Siew
review_text: Forget to take pictures, the chicken is good, but rice is too soft, as in too much water. The coffee not too fantastic.

author: Junze Cao
review_text: Homemade food is alright, service is very unprofessional. Atmosphere is crowded and loud, no air conditioning.

author: Shaina
review_text:
I actually had a mild case of gastroenteritis that day, but since I was in Singapore, I couldn't miss the things on my bucket list, so I ordered a quarter chicken and vegetarian fried rice. The chicken was incredibly tender and not greasy at all! It was much lighter than I expected, and I highly recommend it. The vegetarian fried rice was also delicious!

The drinks were a bit average, nothing special.

author: Kishor Lal
review_text: Great place to grab a quick coffee, tea, or snack inside Terminal 1 transit area at Changi Airport,  Singapore. Plenty of tables with a nice view of the aircraft. They sell tasty puffs, local food like nasi lemak, bee hoon, and laksa. Fast service and the Malay lady is very friendly. Prices are affordable, especially for staff — hard to find good food at this price in the airport!

author: Sankar Shaji
review_text:
Tiptop is one of our go-to food stalls in the Changi airport terminal now during our long layovers. Some of the items maybe slightly priced higher than other stalls out there. But in comparison, the taste more than makes up for it.
I loved the chicken curry puff so much. And the fried egg bee Hon here was better than the one we had earlier from one of the other stalls. Even the iced coffee was better overall.

author: Ken Tan
review_text: Haven’t had curry puff for a while and wanted a light snack.  Saw TipTop curry puff stall and tried out their flaky puff set.  Chicken curry flaky puff tasted ok but will prefer the normal curry puff which contain egg and have a firmer bite.  Teh tasted reasonably good.

author: Chelsia Gelbert
review_text: Feel very disappointed customer service. Not cashier lady, 2nd lady trying to take my order not only fail listening my request I asking for less sambal but she gave me more, i did said it was ok but she said she can help me changed the order this time she really did not put any sambal as I said for less sambal and the 3th lady said no need put chicken wing any more which my order come with chicken wing (but lucky she have give me). Was so rude !!!!The way you service customer feel very disappointed me even i staff also consider customer. Please serve customer equal!!!

author: Fairy
review_text:
The flaky curry chicken puff was delicious, with a generous portion of filling.

However, the teh C was mediocre—the tea lacked flavour and wasn’t particularly enjoyable.

Service was good and fast.

author: Bunga N
review_text:
Somehow, its the only halal food I found here. Turns out it tastes good👍🏻
Didn't get to try the puff tho☹️ maybe next time😉

author: Anastasia G
review_text:
The curry puffs and laksa were delicious.
The prices are reasonable.
Very quick service and plenty of tables nearby.
Nothing fancy but good food.

The place is obviously  popular.

I would recommend this place for a quick bite between your flights.

author: Mel C
review_text: Default size of drink is Large. Staff will serve and charge you for a Large even though there's a Regular size available. They did not ask and take the opportunity to upsell. Both staff at the counter were so quick to respond(when questioned) as though it was already a planned tactic.

author: jayden
review_text: Felt only the bee hoon was nice(a little salty was still had the traditional local bee hoon taste), the other small one stick finger food was not nice, quality isn't there, can taste it's of a lower quality frozen kind. Quite pricey though as compared to the other stalls around the area with portion and quality.

author: jamie chue
review_text: Better watch out. They will give you a Large if you didn’t state the size of drink you want, even though the choices are Regular & Large. When questioned, the staff said it’s because you didn’t say, therefore a large one was assumed. Luckily they didn’t have a choice of an extra large cup of coffee 🙄

author: Keat Chiew
review_text:
Pretty average fare. Ordered the bee hoon set 3 with wing. Chicken curry puff and a teh C kosong.

Bee hoon is ok but the wing is tasteless. Sambal is overly sweet. The curry puff is a disappointment.

Unfortunately, the food did not live up to its namesake, Tip Top. Sadly, will not be coming back any time soon.

author: Yongxing Xu
review_text: I’m not sure if I got her name right but Sherine or Cherine took her time to explain the various food options to me. This helped me make the right food choices for my 4 year old which is very important to me. Thank you for your patience and advice! Much appreciated!

author: K M
review_text:
It's open 24 hours!

Kopi is very nice. Beehoon with chicken wing is a good homely meal before you leave the country.

author: Henry Cheng
review_text: I must admit the Nasi Lemak is pretty decent here. In fact, it’s better than many places. The rice was light and fluffy, each grain infused with coconut taste. Chicken wing was served hot and crispy as well. The sambal was good too as it was flavourful without being overly spicy.

author: Ben Forbes
review_text: Delicious curry puffs and only $2-2.30. You can't go wrong. Curry chicken and egg was the best.

author: Y Teo
review_text:
cashier and server are not working in sync.

ordered milk tea less sugar but the tea without any tea flavor is super sweet.  ordered chicken curry puff but was given flaky puff.  exchange for the right chicken curry puff but the puff is cold.  This is far from “tip top” as claimed!

A disappointment at a world class airport.

author: Otto Lai
review_text: Tried the beef rendang puff, buttery and flaky crust with curry like beef rendang filling, not bad in taste but very fattening, felt very guilty after consumption. Guilty as charged.

author: Agan Agen
review_text: I ordered nasi lemak, it tastes good. I came for the second time to transit at changi airport, first in 2023 and yesterday on January 1, 2025. The taste has not changed. The nasi lemak is delicious and addictive

author: Michelle L
review_text:
truly disappointed. this was over $10 if i can remember.

it’s so pathetic. the chicken cutlet were also really dry.

author: Carys Barton
review_text: Just went here to buy some a snack before my flight to find lobster skewers piled ontop of the vegetarian food - Staff didn't seem to understand the issue with this. Dread to think what other cross-contamination goes on

author: Kuanyi (Chloe)
review_text:
One of the most comfortable business-class lounges I’ve visited in Singapore.

The service here is truly outstanding ☺️warm, attentive, and proactive without being overbearing. A heartfelt thank you to Hazel, Elsy, Alvin, Stary, Pinky, and Divan for their genuine hospitality and thoughtful service throughout my visit.

The dining experience feels closer to fine dining than a typical airport lounge. Most dishes are made to order, which means fewer buffet options, but everything is refined, beautifully presented, and genuinely delicious.

The shower rooms are spacious, spotless, and fully equipped. The lounge itself is calm, quiet, and incredibly relaxing. It’s really perfect for enjoying a proper meal and unwinding before a flight.

author: Alex Soares
review_text:
We had a wonderful time at the Qatar lounge, from the reception to the food to the great facilities.
The whole team was outstanding, specially Hazel, Pinky, Stary and Montra, they looked after us and we're very attentive during dinner time, they really went the extra mile.

There are different areas to dine, work, relax, including some lovely private pods.
The washrooms were always spotless.
This is probably the best airline lounge I've ever visited, it's a joy spending time here before a flight.

author: Vemar Latigay
review_text:
Third time in this lounge and it didn’t disappoint. The food, the amenities and the service are the best that I’ve ever had out of all One World lounges I’ve visited in Changi Airport. First, the food is delicious. There are several choices for you to choose and they vary their menus for each cycle. Personally, I love the Lamb Chops, and for this specific visit their steak which was cooked to perfection.

A really big shoutouts to the service crew (I have to take their names to thank them personally): Hazel, Divan, Dian, Elsy, Jessy, Marissa. Some of them have served me for all the visits I made, and I say, the service makes this Lounge a standout.

Highly recommended and would definitely be back again.

author: George Lim
review_text:
Great lounge experience at Changi Airport

Had my first visit to the Qatar Airways Premium Lounge at Changi Airport, and it was a great experience.

The lounge is cozy, comfortable, and not crowded. The atmosphere is calm and relaxing. The staff were very friendly and attentive — special thanks to Hazel, Montra, Pinky, Start, and Alvin for their excellent service and helpful food and drink recommendations.

Overall, very good service and a pleasant place to spend time before a flight. Would definitely visit again.

author: Roz
review_text:
First time here, I think the girl at check in gave us the wrong directions because me and another 2 pax ended up at the SATS Premium Lounge instead. The entrance of the lounge is designed quite uniquely but I think a proper concierge desk to hide the unsightly paperwork would have been a lovely finishing touch.

The lounge is smaller than the cavernous spaces at Doha but it was warm and inviting. I liked that they had the little pods like the QSuites and there were plenty of seats. The staff were so kind and friendly, and would have served me the whole menu I think, if she could.

I had the lamb, the sushi and the laksa. All the dishes were tasty and done well. The only weird thing was that the laksa was served in a plate instead of a bowl.

A fellow guest was loudly FaceTiming and one of the staff went over to ask him to lower his volume.

Big bonus for a halal menu!

author: Kevin Cai
review_text: I flew a red-eye and was already exhausted from my previous leg, but the exceptional service made all the difference. The bathrooms and showers were spotless, the food was freshly prepared, and the drinks came out quickly and perfectly made. Most importantly, the staff were incredibly accommodating and friendly - a big shout-out to Hazel, Elsy, Jessy, Pinky, Alvin, Divan, and Marissa for truly enhancing my overall flying experience.

author: Mandy Goh
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
It was my first visit to the Qatar Airways Lounge at Changi Airport Terminal 1, and the entire experience was exceptional from start to finish. The staff were incredibly attentive, and the service was truly impeccable.

A special shout-out to Hazel, Elsy, Alvin, and Anu — they went above and beyond to ensure every need was well taken care of and consistently checked in with genuine warmth and professionalism.

Not forgetting the amazing food selection on the menu — everything was served hot, delicious, and beautifully presented. The options were quite extensive, though it would be great to see a few more dessert choices added in the future.

This is truly what premium service should feel like. It’s no surprise that Qatar Airways continues to uphold its world-class standards and win awards. I’m already looking forward to returning to this lounge and flying with Qatar again as a frequent traveller!

author: J
review_text:
An absolute delight, honestly feels and runs more like a restaurant more than a airport lounge

Private , zen, peaceful

Friendly and approachable staff especially hazel , Elsy, Alvin , Jessy

Personalised service

Food was of restaurant quality and its Ala carte , cook fresh on order not a buffet style.

Tempura was a miss because it’s so blend even with the sauce

The lamb was cooked beautiful with a good wine parring recommendation

No doubt the best business class lounge in Changi.

Honestly , I have no idea how they could have further improved, it’s first class lounge standard right here

author: Joshua Chua
review_text: The Qatar lounge experience at Changi T1 is super luxurious. The lounge can comfortably accommodate the premium passengers on their flights. The food is also exceptional from their Ala carte menu. Special mention to Hazel, Divan, Ben, Cs and Ann for their hospitality, great food and drink! Will definitely come back again if I ever get the opportunity to!

author: 回答用
review_text:
Everything was perfect!
I want to thank all staff, Hazel, Stacy, Piwky, Jessy, Divan, Eva and Ann.
They are all kind and sweet to my family.
This lounge was the best place I ever experienced!
I recommend Singapore sling and stake especially!

author: Shane Kelly
review_text: If you’re flying a OneWorld airline this is Singapore airport’s best lounge to go! The quality of food and wines is a step above BA or QF lounges. (Even the First lounges). The shower rooms are nice and cool and all accessories are provided. Amazing service delivered by Hazel, Alvin, Elsy, Ben, Harvin, Anu and Eva!  A lovely experience for 3 hours while in transit. Thank you ❤️ See you again sometime soon

author: Lee Lin Ping
review_text:
I have been to some lounges in my time and the Qatar premium lounge blows every one of them out of the water. The ala carte style and the attentive service of the staff left nothing to be desired and I will not hesitate to unreservedly recommend this lounge to anyone.

Chicken satay and Thai chicken curry - get these. The former gives SQ's version a run for its money.

Hazel, Anthony, Anu, CS, Diuan, Jessy - you were amazing and made our stay so enjoyable and memorable!

author: Adeline Rebekah Peh
review_text: The service at the Changi Airport Qatar lounge is amazing. They have lockers for travellers to store their bags. I was served by Hazel, Else, Jessy, Pinky, and Anu this evening. The staff are so attentive right from when you enter. They kept coming to check that I had everything I needed and that all was in order. There is a small cold buffet station and ala carte menu. I ordered the burrata as an appetizer, lamb rack, and chocolate fondant. So good. The lamb was juicy, even though I left it sitting for awhile (busy attacking the burrata). I heard that the grilled beef tenderloin is really good too but sadly, I was too full.

author: Derek H
review_text:
The Qatar Airways Lounge at Singapore Changi is an exceptional pre-flight retreat that perfectly balances comfort and excellent service. The seating areas are spacious and beautifully styled, offering both quiet corners and social spaces.

The food selection is great, as are the premium champagnes.

Staff are warm, attentive, and a great asset to the lounge making the visit more personal and enjoyable. Special mention for Hazel and her colleagues Stary, Pinky and Montra. All exceptional and welcoming.

Overall, the Qatar Airways Lounge in Singapore delivers a world-class lounge - a perfect start to your journey 👍🏼

author: Chungster UK
review_text:
First time at a Qatar Premium Lounge, and the lounge at Changi T1 is simply amazing.

Special thanks to the team of Hazel, Elsy, Stary, Pinky, Jessy, Divan and Alvin for their superb,  professional, 1st class service throughout.

The food was also excellent and very tasty (had tempura prawns, chicken satay and red thai chicken curry with rice).

Thank you so much for making us feel so welcome . I will definitely try to experience a QSuite flight in the future!

author: Seng Kang
review_text:
I have visited numerous business-class airline lounges, some of which are cozy while others offer exceptionally refined service.

The Qatar Airways lounge in Singapore is absolutely exquisite. The staff are highly professional and genuinely kind, and the drinks and food are simply perfect.

I would especially like to extend my sincere thanks to Hazel, Montra, Stary, Alvin, Pinky, and Divan.

author: MAKI
review_text: I visited this lounge before catching a late-night JAL flight. It's not large, but it's not crowded and is a very nice lounge. The relaxed atmosphere and excellent service made for a very enjoyable stay. The staff were also very attentive. If I have the opportunity to visit Singapore again, I will definitely visit this lounge. Thank you to Hezel, Alvin, CS, Jessie, and Azfar for your wonderful service. The Singapore Sling was delicious.

author: lloyd teo
review_text: Great food and top notch services by the team here at Qatar premium lounge. Big shout out to Hazel, Elsy, Jessy, Pinky and Divan for the hospitality. Thank you all for making my journey with Qatar a pleasant one!

author: Gail U
review_text: Visited the lounge this evening for the first time. This lounge is amazing, the team treated me as a special guest as if it were a top rated hotel. The shower was fantastic, spotless and great towels and toiletries. The food is a la carte and restaurant quality. The staff were by far the best bit, offering wine pairings, making sure the experience was exceptional. Honestly, I have been to a lot of airport  lounges and this is unlike any other. A big thank you to Hazel, Dian, Alvin, CS, Azfar and Ben - you are amazing hosts and you could not have been more attentive! Thank you.

author: Sidney Ng
review_text: First time at the Qatar airways lounge and was blown away by the atmosphere and service! The team's service is tremendous and always ensuring that we are taken care of. Shoutout to Hazel, Elsy, Dinky and Divan for taking care of me before my flight!! Special shoutout to Hazel for helping me find ways to cut away my hangnail on my finger!! 💕

author: Thinley Choden
review_text: Harry's was a nice, ambient, and quiet place to sit down in the hustle and bustle of Changi airport. I really enjoyed the french toast with the fresh coffee. I am glad I happened upon it while exploring the airport. I appreciate XC for being so friendly and for the excellent service! :)

author: Jack R
review_text: Regretted coming here yesterday for something to eat.Worst cook ever. I’d give negative rating. One rating is too good for them. Skewers burned on one side and pale almost uncooked on the flip side. Inside the chicken is still pink raw. Disgusting.Actual is worst than photo. Better food upstairs. Met a family who transited a couple of weeks back at harry ‘s and also shared their awful food experience. They were given a burger that was pink raw on the inside but burnt on the outside. But, the bacon on the burger was burnt!  Bacon on ceasar salad  was also burned. Pizza overbaked. Really too bad their kitchen is their weakest link. No quality control. Otherwise, this is a great place to unwind and have drink. Staff are pleasant. Change your kitchen staff.

author: Tom Tyrone Beiron Tay
review_text: Where is there a quiet yet happy environment in Terminal One Transit you can enjoy a sip, delicious meal and a respite from work or travel… Right here at Harry’s for sure. Whether in airport staff uniform or holiday travel attire, Kuya and Claire will be perfect hosts to welcome and help you chill before you get up go. Love the Jazz Burger - my favourite here, thanks to the wagyu beef patty (not in the photos) - and have had the chilli crab pasta and sweet and sticky pork skewers (highly recommend these!), as well as the superbly prepared chicken tikka served with naan flat bread. The latter has won the heart and palate of at least one mate. Service here at Harry’s T1 is warm, cosy, genuine and yes, just about the best within Changi’s Transit area. You can also find them at Terminal 3, and the staff do move between both locations. Again, Kuya and Claire and their terrific colleagues, will be on hand to help you enjoy your meal and chill. Don’t be shy, come in… and yes, do drop a tip and neat review here for them, too.

author: Wolf Hester
review_text:
All prices on Menu exclude:
- Service Charges 10% 😬
- GST 9%
Hope the food is worth it.
Food extremely tasty.
Amend your prices on the menu.. to include the above charges..

author: Karissa Kang
review_text:
Great place to drink before your flight! It was especially quiet during the Midnight, fantastic place to have a drink and chill alone.
Was served by Ju seng, friendly fun and warmth guy. Was looking through the menu and there wasn’t any cocktail that suited me, asked if he could do me a whiskey sour (was off menu), he gladly agreed and guess what! I’m a big fan of Whiskey sour and it’s only today I’ve learnt from him that egg white could be added for an extra creamy and foamy texture to the drink. It was my first time trying it with egg added, IT WAS FANTASTIC, probably the best whiskey sour I’ve had anywhere before!

author: Sharif Sha
review_text: Visited for a quick drink and had a lovely cocktail. Pricey but nice. Staff could be more friendly and warm.

author: Andrew Eills
review_text: Great pizzas, Cesar Salad and Satay Chicken.  Really good prices.  Orange juice was freshly squeezed and very good value.  It was nice to step into the friendly atmosphere of Harry's and have a good meal before out flight.  Highly recommended.

author: Sara Shump
review_text: Had a wonderful experience at Harry’s in the Singapore airport. Wendy was my server and was so friendly, helpful and made the absolute best aviation drinks !

author: Mi Hyun Lee
review_text:
Usually my friend and myself visit this place quite sometimes for breakfast or coffee :)
Love to see staff Wendy here, she is very friendly and provided excellent service , appreciate to Ms Wendy for her table service and all , we would happy to see her next time as well , we are big fan of Harry’s :) cheers :)

author: M. C. B. P.
review_text: So chill this place, my preferred place to hang out for a couples of drinks before my flight. Do drop by and find out yourself. And all the staff here are so friendly and nice. OMG 5 stars for sure ! Nice nachos too btw.

author: sumi kelly
review_text: Clare was really pleasant qnd explained that the kitchen closes at 10 so we had some items from the supper menu… my husbands Kilkenny tasted odd but the service staff were very kind to change his drink to a bottle beer. All in all it was a pleasant experience.  Thank you Clare and bar tender for you fabulous service.

author: Ren Moslares
review_text:
Best place in Changi Airport Terminal 1!

I am quite amazed by the interior of this place, it is very spacious and comfy! You can even play golf while killing time with cold drinks and the best choices of food.

They have enough space for luggage, too! There is also a nearby toilet, you can always ask the friendly-homey team member to look after your stuff and run to the loo.

Always a must-stop when I am flying at Terminal 1! Kudos to the team at Changi Airport Terminal 1.

author: Ricky Chin
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Had an amazing dining experience here! The staff were super friendly and attentive, making us feel very welcome. The food was absolutely delicious and full of flavor 😋 Everything was perfect — I’ll definitely come back again! Highly recommended!

author: Stuart Wilkinson
review_text: Wendy and the team made us feel super comfortable and looked after, even going so far to put the football on the big screen so we could watch the finals, also the beer was cold and as tasty as an Aussie needed. Love this pub xxx

author: Ash Mowbray
review_text:
For the price charged, this is not what a bacon sandwich should look like! A couple of scraps of bacon, mostly fat, served on T he cheapest bread they could find, soaked in butter. It tasted fine, but a total rip off.
That said… if you want a “western” style breakfast, it’s one of the cheaper options in the terminal.
And I must say the service from the lady working on the bar was fantastic!

author: Lyn Tual
review_text: Wendy is always cheerful and very helpful. She provides excellent service.

author: John Donaldson
review_text:
Had a great time when I was here during the day. In the night the “service” is rude and incompetent. Staff at far corner looking at phone. I walk over. He looks up impatiently. “Welcome sir! Have a seat!”  Nope. “Are you open?” Yes. Disinterest. “Can I sit?” Yes. Look at menu. He is at far corner looking at phone. I get up to leave. He comes over. I sit. He tells me only then kitchen is closed. I leave. Too bad.

Compared to last time when the server Wendy is awesome. Very friendly. Great service. Good food. Like that Long Island w blue berry

author: Alvin B. Kristian
review_text: The waitress or bartender was very friendly. The drink i chose was berry long island tea. It’s very refreshing. Unfortunately, this place is not busy because I think its location is a bit out of the way.

author: Le Summer
review_text:
Happening was there today. Relax and chill with nice food, nice view and awesome service by Wendy.
Glad to have her today, make my trip in Singapore with good mood

author: Gabby GG
review_text: Best time to come when there's no people around so you just can just enjoy the music and watch the live sport match without interruptions. xc always come to check on me, can see that she is good person but I am a bit worried if she really ok working alone at midnight til sunrise.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: joseph ng
review_text: Finally we get to try this Michelin star Bak kut teh!. totally satisfied  and happy!! Ordered the premium loin soup, its is good as advertised! The soup is thick &  flovourful and not salty.  the chicken feet is surprisingly good!! It's so good, nothing left!

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Dar Tsai
review_text: Fr, the broth is next lvl. It's like, so rich n comforting but also has that perfect peppery kick from the garlic ＆ herbs. Srsly hits the spot. It's super flavorful tho not heavy - u could drink it all day. Best part? They give free refills.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Hai Phan (Francis)
review_text: The restaurant serves delicious Chinese food. The restaurant is usually crowded so you have to queue to be served. The staff is very friendly and enthusiastic. The prices are reasonable.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Anastasiia
review_text: Great place, deserves its michelen stars. There was the queue to enter, but it was not so long, around 30 minutes, not over. While I was waiting, I was offered the small fan (on the back side, you can see all chain restaurants in Singapore. Than they gave the small paper with queue number, you can pre-order food while waiting, it was very convenient. I have ordered pork rib soup and pork tenderloin. It was super delicious, only they offered to refill the soup if you have finished it. Perfect and highly recommended!

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: O Ting (Stardust)
review_text: Not actually bad the Bakuteh. The pork ribs are very tasty. And the tea also strong and nice. Staffs were quite attentive. But found dish-wash scouring pad after I finished my meal.🙃🙈

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Eddy
review_text:
Song Fa Bak Kut Teh at New Bridge Road is one of those places I keep coming back to, and it never disappoints. This particular outlet is my favorite. It sits on a corner shophouse, open and airy, with a very comfortable feel even when it is busy. I have never dined at their other branches because this one already feels just right for me.

The atmosphere here is simple and welcoming. Natural airflow, high ceilings, and the classic shophouse charm make the whole meal more enjoyable. It feels relaxed and unpretentious, exactly how bak kut teh should be enjoyed.

The star of the show is, of course, the bak kut teh. The peppery broth is bold, aromatic, and deeply satisfying. Every sip warms you up and keeps you reaching for more. The pork is tender and cooked just right, soaking up all that beautiful peppery goodness. It is the kind of dish that tastes consistent every single time, which is why I always enjoy eating here.

The sides deserve special mention. Honestly, do not skip them. The sides here elevate the whole experience. From the ones I ordered, they are easily some of the best sides you can pair with bak kut teh. Each dish complements the soup perfectly and adds variety to the meal. I really recommend ordering the sides generously, as they make the table feel complete.

Apologies for my photos, as a few side dishes were missing when I took them. We also had the braised pork samchan and intestines served on one plate, which were rich, flavorful, and very well done. There was also the trio of boiled peanuts and tofu, plus one more item on the same plate that slipped my mind, all comforting and nicely seasoned. And of course, the dough fritters are a must. Dipping them into the hot soup is one of the best parts of the meal.

Song Fa Bak Kut Teh at New Bridge Road remains my go-to spot for bak kut teh in Singapore. Great food, a comfortable setting, and consistently satisfying flavors. This is one of those places I will always return to without hesitation. Highly recommended.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Heidi
review_text:
Super yummy and comforting meal! The pork rib soup was rich, bold, and perfectly peppery – the pork was super tender and fell right off the bone. Loved that they refill the soup too! The braised large intestines were flavorful and well-prepared, and the iced lemon tea was a great refreshing balance to the heat. Definitely a must-try for anyone craving a classic Singaporean bak kut teh experience.

Do prepare for a queue – I waited around 10–15 minutes, but they were so sweet to offer a fan and a drink while waiting, which made the experience really pleasant.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Victor Caindec
review_text: As tourists in Singapore, this is our favorite go-to place for bah ku teh. Food is consistently great (see photo), and the service is always pleasant. Deanna and her team deserve 5 stars. Will be back again soon.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: k4rsaya
review_text: in my visit list everytime i travel to singapore. light but flavoural broth. the ribs were so tender and juicy. worth a try

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: 권하림
review_text:
Overrated and Poor Service

Waited over 20 minutes at this Michelin-recommended spot. While the welcome drink was a nice touch, they only accepted cash or Alipay due to a machine issue—with no prior notice.

Food was okay, but the service was terrible. Staff were unfriendly and couldn’t communicate in English, which made things difficult as a tourist. When I complained about undercooked noodles, there was no apology, and they were still not properly cooked when returned.

Asking for a napkin resulted in being scolded and told I had to pay for it—which felt very unwelcoming. Despite the wait, there were plenty of empty tables inside.

Would not recommend for tourists. Disappointing overall.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Howie
review_text: I know this brand might be quite popular in Singapore, but for me, the actual experience this time was just average in terms of taste. Their bak kut teh soup is pretty decent and has some unique flavor, but if you try other dishes, the taste is really average—at least for me, it wasn’t anything impressive. Overall, I think it’s not as good as the lotus root and pork rib soup from Wuhan. There were a lot of customers, and I waited in line for about 10 minutes. The seating inside was quite cramped. At first, somehow, our table didn’t have the condiment rack like the other tables. I had to ask twice before the staff finally provided it. In addition, I saw a flie in the restaurant, and it landed on the plates or table multiple times—I had to wave it away several times. So annoying. 😳

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Alex Wong
review_text: This is my first time trying Singapore bak kut teh. I'm impressed with the Michelin Bib Gourmand achievement, and they have their own uniqueness tastes as compared to Malaysia bak kut teh. To be honest, I loved both of them. There is nothing to compare about who is having the best bak kut teh between the 2 countries. However, 1 thing I learned from Song Fa is the proper way to drink Chinese tea, and it shouldn't be soaked in the teapot for more than 20 seconds. Otherwise, it will taste bitter. This is one thing which is not "educated" in the famous Malaysia Klang bak kut teh. Therefore, an additional point for Song Fa. I even went to have my dinner on the second night at The Centrepoint outlet. I will definitely be back again in the future.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Bee Choo Cheng
review_text: Michelin star restaurant and there was no Q. I checked with the staff how to order and they give me a QR code to order. I ordered pork rib soup and pork tenderloin. Both were delicious and the meat was tender. The salted veggies was soft. The dough fritters were not hot and crispy. The caixin was a bit too soft. The staff will walked around to offer to refill the soup if you have finished it. The disappointment with this outlet is when I asked the staff to give me extra soup when they served the food, he did not give us extra bowl or soup. I have to ask from other staff.  Overall still a perfect and highly recommended place for Singapore style BKT.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Takahiro Koyama
review_text:
If you're looking for an authentic taste of Singaporean local food, you've got to try Bak Kut Teh, and Song Fa is definitely the place to do it. This popular dish is a peppery, savory pork rib soup, and it's commonly enjoyed with a bowl of white rice or alongside "油条 / Dough Fritters" for dipping.

Song Fa is a renowned establishment with a impressive track record, boasting 14 outlets across Singapore and earning the Michelin Bib Gourmand award for eight consecutive years (2016-2024).

Their menu features their signature Bak Kut Teh Soup Dishes, along with Braised Dishes, various vegetable sides, and small plates. They also have a good selection of Chinese teas to complement your meal.

Now, let's talk about the Bak Kut Teh itself. The pork ribs are incredibly tender and fall-off-the-bone, yet still have a satisfying texture. The quality of the meat is excellent—you can really taste the rich pork flavor, and there's absolutely no smell. The soup is a clear, flavorful broth, bursting with the essence of pork and pork bones. It's a delightful blend of salty notes with a strong kick of white pepper, plus a wonderful aroma and taste of garlic. A fantastic bonus at Song Fa is that soup refills are free!

For those who want to savor the pure meatiness, I highly recommend the "特级龙骨汤 / Premium Loin Rib Soup." If you prefer to enjoy the sweet, melt-in-your-mouth fattiness, then the "排骨肉骨茶 / Pork Ribs Soup" is the way to go!

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Kero Chan
review_text:
We waited for around 15 minutes on a Sunday early evening. The line was quite efficient; staff handed out QR code for you to place order in advance so food could come accordingly once you seated.

Food were overall very tasty and in small portions, which was good because you could order many more to try. My personal favourites are their Pork Ribs Soup and the large intestines. The fact that they would refill the soups nonstop makes the experience even better.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: N Park
review_text:
I arrived 20 minutes before the restaurant opened but had to wait another 30 minutes. When you’re near the front of the line, the staff gives you a QR code to place your order. The food comes out quickly once you’re seated.
The food was good. The bak kut teh was especially nice, and they offer unlimited refills of the broth. I liked the other dishes as well. I also had lemon tea, which was sweet and pleasant.
Even with the long wait, the place is worth trying.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Alfred Balaga
review_text:
**Context: Weekday Dinner**

We visited the restaurant with a group of five, including three adults and two children. We appreciated being seated immediately, which is helpful to note for future visits.

The service was prompt, and the ordering process was straightforward. It’s essential to pay close attention, as the delivery of their English may vary.

The food was pretty enjoyable. The flavors were well-balanced, with none being overly strong or emphasized. The sauces, served on the side, complemented our dishes nicely.

Overall, we had a positive experience and would easily recommend this place. Anyone planning a visit should be mindful of peak times to ensure prompt seating.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Louwil Cadorna
review_text: First time I ate Bak Ku Teh! And it didnt disappoint, so yummy! Deana, thanks for your great service!

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Tommy Byun
review_text:
A super famous Bak Kut Teh (a.k.a. meat bone tea) franchise in the heart of Singapore city center! This is the one place that opens up one hour early at 10am, whereas the rest of the locations open at 11am!

It was packed from the beginning when we got there at 10:08 AM, and we got lucky, and got the last table open after it opened!

We ordered a few bone soups, braised pork, and vegetable dish (refer to the receipt), and they were all quite good as expected. The food wasn't heavy, the portion wasn't to overwhelming, and it was one of the cheapest meals we had in Singapore as well! The soup wasn't too heavy or oily, and it was soothing to the stomach. The soup itself was also refillable for free! One negative I have to say is that it seemed to have too much pepper. I actually found the bak kut teh I had in Rasapura Masters food court better tasting than here!

Everything was very efficient, ordering online through QR code, and they serve you right away. The staff was friendly and attentive even though it was really busy.

By the time we got out (in 40 minutes or so), there was a huge line up outside. However, because there are many tables, and the rotation is quite fast, so you probably won't have to wait too much in the line.

I would strongly recommend to go to this place right when it opens, and for only a group of 4 or less.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Claire
review_text: Great place to enter into exploring the taste of bak kut teh. This particular place does not seem to have an overwhelming aroma of herbal infusion, so it is good to try as a first bak kut teh. Meat is so tender and soft, and the soup is peppery and clean.

author: Sandra
review_text: Affordable vegetarian food at staff canteen. The quality is good too! Ordered horfun and it was cooked freshly upon order. Wok hei is nice, totally enjoyed my meal before my flight!

author: Prabha Iyer
review_text: This was a good experience.. We had vegetarian options and this was a budget friendly compared to the other restaurants.. The staff were courteous and answered yo our queries humbly and respectfully.. You may try here as this is much recommended..

author: Priskha Trivenna
review_text: A budget-friendly place to eat at Changi Airport — the concept is like a canteen, with lots of different food stalls. To get here, you really have to ask the staff for directions because we kept getting lost 🥲 even though it’s cheap, the portions are huge — one serving is enough for two people! As for the taste… well, it’s a bit plain 🤏 and it turns out there’s even a price difference between staff and visitors!

author: Tim C
review_text: There's a fully vegan place here that I want to. Food was super cheap but some of the best I've eaten in Singapore.

author: Yulia Christina
review_text: Very cheap hotel with strategis location , room clean & nice place...the breakfast delicious & service also very good. Recommend this hotel & will come back to this hotel if come to Bali 😍

author: Yellow Bear
review_text:
The Orchis Food Court (Staff Canteen) is a budget-friendly dining spot compared to the usual airport restaurants and cafés.
For vegans and vegetarians, there’s a Chinese vegetarian stall (温馨素食园) with vegan options and other
non-vegetarian stalls with meatless options like Bismillah Food Express, an Indian Muslim food stall.

** To get to Orchis Food Court (Staff Canteen), just walk all the way to the right hand corner of Terminal One Level One, then follow the signage to the Staff Canteen and take a lift down to B1.

author: lontongstroong
review_text:
This place is already pretty famous among budget-conscious travelers who are based in SG or connect through SIN. It's intended as staff cafeteria and thus not surprising that the location is pretty hidden. Unlike the staff cafeteria in Terminal 4 which is readily accessible through the landside/check in area, one has to exit the terminal and enter the basement, which is next to the parking building. Follow the signage "Staff Canteen" to get to the place.

The stalls are of standard fare and variety of normal food courts. Of course for everyone who isn't airport staff the price is slightly more expensive, but it's still far cheaper than the stuffs inside the terminal. Always come before the dinner crowd, the ventilation quality inside the food court is acceptable (CO2 concentration never goes above threshold of 800 ppm), which is surprising since it's location in the basement. Note that the only drink stall isn't well stocked and often run out of the menu before dinner time *shrugging*.

author: Jovell Gan
review_text:
I found a nice and affordable vegetarian stall inside the Staff Canteen at Terminal 1.

Despite the name, it is open to everyone, not just airport staff, which is a pleasant surprise.

Do note that it is located before immigration (non-transit area), not after security, so it’s suitable if you’re sending someone off, picking someone up, or haven’t cleared immigration yet.

Operating hours: 0730-1830

author: AM Lim
review_text: A pleasant food court at Changi T1 for people in-transit like me to grab a quick meal before connecting to the next flight. Plenty of food choices available to choose from - Western, Chinese even Indian cuisines. Reasonable price. The place is clean and spacious. Lastly have a courtesy to clean up and send the tray and your used plates cutlery and everything else back to the designated collection area after finished. Overall great place for traveller looking for quick meal at T1.

author: Balaji Thiyagarajan
review_text:
Orchis Food Court at Changi Airport is a fantastic culinary spot that offers an impressive variety of local and international dishes in a convenient and comfortable setting. It’s perfect for travelers who want to enjoy a delicious meal without leaving the airport. The food court is spacious and clean, with plenty of seating options that accommodate solo diners, families, and groups.
One of the best things about Orchis Food Court is the wide selection of food stalls, serving everything from comforting local Singaporean favorites like Hainanese chicken rice and laksa to diverse Asian and Western dishes. The food quality is consistently good, with fresh ingredients and authentic flavors that satisfy cravings and provide a memorable dining experience. Prices are reasonable, especially considering the prime airport location, making it a great value for both quick bites and leisurely meals before or after flights.
The atmosphere is lively yet relaxed, with friendly service from the vendors. It’s a convenient place to refuel, whether during a layover or before departure, and the variety means there’s something for everyone. For those looking to sample Singapore’s famous food without venturing far, Orchis Food Court is a reliable and tasty choice right inside Changi Airport.

author: Emm Gee
review_text: Bad experience at this food court. Firstly, the air cond doesn’t work and it was stuffy.  Food is expensive by food court standards . We ordered ban Mian and it was simply just a bowl of carbo for $5! The amount of mince meat was less than a spoonful with very few super small ikan bilis. Pork chop or nugget size cost $1 per piece

author: Will
review_text:
At ard 8pm, most stalls were closed.

There was a smell from the disinfectant, cleaning and waste food.

At level 1, hunt for the staff canteen sign, turn left, there’s 2 small n one larger lift. Take either of the 2 small lifts n not the large lift to reach #B1.

Lifts looks like door, poor design, walk all the way inwards to look carefully for the lifts. If no signage, I would properly not walked in to spot the lifts.

author: s vivekananda
review_text: Excellent food court with variety of local hawker food offerings including dosa,  noodles,  popiah, rojak,  chendol, fried rice 🍚.  Open 24 hours.  Pricing is reasonable and preparation of orders is prompt.  Dine in or takeaway options available

author: Engkarat Techapanurak
review_text: Super cheap food provided here for staff and public as well. A bit difficult to realize the place. Need to go a bit outside of the airport terminal to get to this place. Google map's location is correct.

author: Raditya
review_text:
A Hidden Foodie Paradise in the Middle of the City!

Orchis Food Court is an absolute gem — if you know, you know! It’s the kind of place that looks unassuming from the outside but completely overdelivers once you step in. Tons of local vendors, amazing variety, and everything feels super fresh and made with care.

I tried the Thai basil chicken, boat noodles, and mango sticky rice — all delicious, affordable, and served fast. Whether you’re a traveler or a local looking for quick, tasty eats, this spot hits the mark every time.

Clean seating, good vibes, and zero pretension. Perfect for casual lunches or quick bites after shopping or sightseeing. Don’t sleep on this one!

author: arif rahmanto
review_text:
Good for looking affoy food

The interesting is Halal food and Haram food has different place including the utensils.

Perfect

author: Harry
review_text:
Found this place while browsing the Internet for cheaper food options in Changi! 🍽️

Tried Item 14 – Fried Noodles with Fragrant Mushroom and Pork from the Taiwan Delight stall — and it was surprisingly good! You can really taste the smoky “wok hei” flavour, and the portion is big enough to share if you’re a small eater.

Definitely worth checking out! Will try more dishes next time I’m at Changi Terminal 1. ✈️🍜
#ChangiEats #BudgetFood #TaiwanDelight #HiddenGem #Item14 #MustTry

author: Franco Migliorati
review_text: Great variety of food stalls, plenty of choice and cousines. Most places only accept cash and there is a specific place for drinks. It is quite hard to find a table as the airport workers also go there for lunch, watch out! A strange thing is that nobody provides napkins, you have to buy it somewhere. An unusual place to find inside an airport. Prices very affordable

author: Jon Tan
review_text:
Feedback on the Chicken Biryani Served at the Orchis Staff Canteen

I would like to raise a serious concern regarding the quality and food safety standards at the Indian food corner of the Orchid staff canteen. Recently, I ordered the chicken biryani from this stall, and the experience was extremely disappointing. More importantly, it posed a potential health risk.

To begin with, the chicken served in the biryani was noticeably undercooked. This is not a minor issue, as consuming undercooked poultry can lead to severe foodborne illnesses caused by harmful bacteria such as salmonella. It is alarming that such a lapse in basic food preparation could occur, especially in an establishment that serves a large number of staff daily.

Beyond the food safety concern, the overall quality of the dish was far below acceptable standards. The biryani lacked proper flavour, aroma, and texture—elements that are essential to this classic dish. Instead of an enjoyable meal, it left a negative impression that raises questions about the stall’s cooking practices and quality control.

Given the potential health hazards and poor food quality, I strongly urge the canteen management to review the stall’s hygiene and food preparation processes. Regular checks, proper staff training, and strict adherence to cooking standards are necessary to prevent such incidents from happening again.

Ensuring that all food vendors maintain high standards is crucial not only for the well-being of staff but also for upholding the reputation of the canteen. I hope that prompt action can be taken to address this issue and improve the overall dining experience for everyone who relies on the Orchid staff canteen.

author: liping cheng
review_text: Located at an inconspicuous corner of Changi Airport Terminal 1, this food court / canteen hosts a wide variety of food. Mala here is 1 of the hot favourites among the airport staff. A special mention goes to the last stall at the far L-corner that sells kuehs. There, sells a heavenly peanut pancake that has crunchy peanuts and fluffy chewy pancake!

author: Scott S
review_text:
A great selection of hawker stalls spread out on 2 floors. Excellent kopi/ local coffee with great service (so you can avoid the Starbucks stores that are popping up on every street corner).
Very friendly vendors who will help out but the vast majority do not speak English (nore should they).
One of the more authentic hawker centres in the area.

author: Sheringham Zhou
review_text:
Missed out on Heng Kee, so I headed to Ah Heng upstairs.
The curry was rich and packed with flavor, and the tau pok absorbed the broth perfectly. Overall, a very satisfying bowl of curry chicken mee.

Thumbs-up!

author: Pete Klimek
review_text:
If you’re looking for the best curry noodles in Singapore, this Bib Gourmand hawker stall is it! (There are two side by side). The wait was about 20 minutes, but let me tell you—it was worth every single second.

The curry is rich, aromatic, and perfectly balanced without being overly heavy. You get to choose your preferred chicken cut, and every piece is tender and juicy. The noodles soak up the curry beautifully, and the portion sizes are just right—generous without being overwhelming.

This is hawker food at its finest: authentic, full of flavour, and absolutely satisfying. Highly, highly recommended!

author: Happy Belly Chef
review_text:
If you’re chasing the ultimate plate of fried kway teow in Singapore, this legendary stall at Hong Lim Market & Food Centre is my top pick. Every visit feels like a reunion with comfort food done right.

The “wok hei” here is unmistakable—smoky, intense, and deeply satisfying. And that signature pork lard smile? It’s not just a garnish, it’s a promise. Crispy, golden bits that elevate every bite with rich, indulgent flavor.

The uncle behind the wok is a master of his craft. He’s meticulous with every plate—balancing sauces, controlling heat, and portioning ingredients with care. You can see the seriousness in his movements, and taste it in the results. Occasionally, a younger assistant takes over when the uncle’s on break. While the finesse may vary slightly, the taste still holds up well and is worth trying.

Be prepared to wait, especially during lunch rush. But honestly? The queue is part of the experience. It builds the anticipation—and the reward is always worth it.

This stall consistently satisfies my cravings. It’s a stall that respects tradition, delivers bold flavors, and never compromises on quality. Whether you’re a local or just visiting, this is one plate you shouldn’t miss.

author: Paul Ciprian
review_text: Lots of small stands with cooked Asian food. Some have long queues, some don't. Stands with natural juices (more or less...). Spartan conditions, with tables and chairs fixed to the floor, self-service, cheap cutlery. Minimal hygiene conditions, crowded, but worth a try.

author: Thomas Saw
review_text:
To me the Best CKT in town, this Outram Park Fried Kway Teow stall at Hong Lim Food center was moved here many years ago from the previous coffee stall below HDB void deck near current Outram Park MRT station.

Stall open Mon-Sat (6am-3pm till sold out), close on Sun/Public Holidays.
I have eaten this stall CKT many times since Y1998. Be prepared to queue 1 hour or more, like today Saturday from 12 noon that I’ve queued 80min before food served. Few customers behind was told sold out today.
CKT is abit moist cooked with egg scramble, many fishcake & bean sprouts semi crunchy. (S$5 small size).

You can end the meal with desserts after CKT which is opposite stall, selling 4 types desserts only at S$2.20.

This Food Center has many stalls award with good & tasty food at affordable prices.

author: Shaolin Leong
review_text: This place is special ! Grandpa's favorite hawker center ! Curry noodles , CKT, prawn noodle, kuey chap, laksa, wanton noodle, curry puff etc . Right in the city ,so things are more expensive over here .Pity those that worked in the city ! But to be fair no dinner crowd. Therefore LPPL ! Can complain can kpkb but nothing can done ! Not happy don't eat type!

author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon
review_text:
Hong Lim Market & Food Centre is a culinary treasure trove that lives up to its stellar reputation. Nestled in a bustling locale, this hawker centre is home to 4 or 5 Michelin-recommended stalls, each offering a unique insight into the richness of local flavors. The energy of the place is palpable—always packed with locals and food enthusiasts alike, eager to experience authentic, top-tier street eats.

One of the biggest draws is the variety of food on offer. Every stall has its own specialty, ranging from meticulously crafted noodles and savory seafood dishes to irresistible satays and innovative twists on traditional recipes. Each Michelin-recommended vendor brings passion and expertise to their craft, ensuring that every bite is a memorable adventure in taste. The quality is consistently high, often rivaling that of more upscale dining establishments, yet served in a refreshingly unpretentious atmosphere.

author: Wittapon Jawjit
review_text: This is a great place to find many traditional Chinese dishes. You can find a branch of a Michelin-starred noodle shop, classic Singaporean pancake, fish ball soup, and many more!!

author: Hatsune Miku
review_text: Hot, stuffy, expensive and long queues is what best describes Hong Lim Food Centre. Most of the stalls here serve average and above fare, so this place is a relatively safe bet. If not for the fact that this place is stuffy and packed, I would have given it 5 stars. Several famous stalls can be found in Hong Lim, the most notable being the fried kway teow, wanton noodles and curry noodles. This food centre has 2 storeys, so please dont forget to visit the second level. This food centre has both quality and quantity, but is in serious need of better ventilation. Based in Chinatown, you can also expect to pay a little more for your food. Overall a pretty good food centre if not for the poor ventilation.

author: Yu Sec
review_text: This is one of the most chaotic and complicated hawker center with strong local atmosphere.  If you want to see real singapore life, I recommend this rather than Lao Pasa or Maxell, that are walking distance from here.

author: Violet Chan
review_text:
We bought curry puffs from two stalls side by side on the 2nd floor — and the verdict is out.
The stall run by the two ladies is hands-down the winner! 🥇

✨ Why it’s the best:
• Super crispy puff pastry
• Generous fillings
• Flavourful and well-seasoned

They offer a mixed potato + sardine filling if you like both, or you can choose just potato or sardine.
💰 $2 each and definitely worth it.

Highly recommend giving it a try! 👍

author: Rick Takeshita
review_text: Still my fav hawker, just avoid lunch queue, unless its Outram ckt n ji ji then always crowded😆

author: L Chan
review_text:
One of the best hawker centre around. Packed with about 100 stalls - many run by veteran hawkers with decades of experience. Some stalls are even Michelin-listed.

One can find a huge variety of local favourite dishes here - from smoky wok hei noodles & rich curry chicken bee hoon, to bak chor mee, Hokkien mee & even traditional desserts. Prices are fair & portions generous. Expect long queues at popular stalls, especially during the lunch rush (12 - 1:30 PM).

Seating can get a little tight & warm during peak hours, but the atmosphere is vibrant & authentically local. A must-visit for anyone wanting to experience real Singapore hawker culture.

author: Cheong Loong
review_text: The Cantonese tze char stall on the ground floor produces creative fushion jap chinese dishes. Manned by a lady chef , she is fast in delivering each order over her 2 woks. She comes up with new dishes so that sveasier gfoe customers to order during busy lunch time . Each dish served pipping hot from her wok n has great visual display that makes it so appetising .

author: M Lee
review_text: MRT to Chinatown Station, connected via Chinatown Point (exit near KFC). Saw queue for curry noodles. Went to upper floor to locate the crayfish hor fun. Found Tuck Kee (Ipoh) Sah Hor Fun (unit 02-40). Only a few customers in the queue since it was after 2.30pm. Had the crayfish with shellfish as lady informed that they had run out of prawns. The quality was good, crayfish were very fresh, sauce was robust not the starchy type. We also enjoyed the Hokkien rice dumpling from Hiong Kee Dumplings (unit 02-37). Portion was huge with generous fillings (pork, mushrooms n chestnut). Saw a group of tourists enjoying numerous curry puffs. Went to check it out, found out that there were 2 stalls (Tanglin Crispy Curry Puff) with rather similar names selling almost the same items. Didn’t try as we were rather full after the crayfish hor fun n rice dumpling. ‘Hi Coffee’ near to crayfish hor fun had perpetual long queue with signage something like ‘expect to wait on the average 35 to 55 minutes’. Keen to give it a try one of these days.

author: Ajilex Fajardo
review_text:
Lots of hawkers available but nice breakfast options can be a bit limited if compared to other centers in the vicinity

What I got is a delicious version of char keow teow with cockles and egg

author: May Wong
review_text:
This eatery has a wide variety of local good food for everyone
Upper flr  ji ji noodle house - 45min-1hr wait
Their soya chicken is well seasoned. Of course if u must try try the chef recommendation - char siew has nice smoked taste.
For coffee my fav - generation coffee roasters at ground flr.
To tapao, get the curry puffs. Both shops along same row (upper floor near the mezannine seating area nearer to chinese pancakes) are michelin recommended. If you are to eat there, take the corner shop crispy puffs. Crumbs can b quite messy. The centre stall curry puff staff is good too.
I am not keen on the michelin curry chicken noodle stall. The curry is more for westerners? Light milk+coconut+ curry. No curry dominant taste. Only saving grace is their salted chillie. Pairs well with the curry noodle.
Go on weekend breakfast timings 9-1030 if you don't want much q.

author: Vincent Ming
review_text:
Came here for some local breakfast. The famous Char Kuey Teow stall and Pork Noodles stall had long lines queuing, but I noticed the Char Kuey Teow serving was quite fast despite the longer queue.

Tai Wah pork noodles took some time before we got our noodles. Probably around 35minutes? Not much to say about the pork noodles. I ordered the dry meepok. It has its’ unique charm, with the touch of vinegar and tiny bit of spicy taste.

The YuanYang from the beverage stall along the same row as the char kuey teow was amazing though! Right amount of kaw.

author: TooGood
review_text:
Very typical local hawker centre in Singapore with lots of stalls to choose from. The food is tasty.

We tried the curry chicken noodles from Ah Heng Curry Chicken Bee Hoon Mee and several beverages from two stalls next to it. Another great dish is the bak kut teh from the stall right next to the curry chicken. Don't miss out the Curry puffs from Tanglin Crispy Curry Puff (Middle Stall). All in all, this centre is a foodie's delight.

Last but not the least, a special shoutout to the cleaners who work tirelessly to keep the space clean and who also kept my sunglasses (which I had forgotten on a table) safely with them until I came back 17 hours later. :)

author: Stefan Nugroho
review_text:
Came here on a Wednesday for dinner. We were almost immediately seated, perhaps due to our early arrival (5pm), and thus the restaurant was not completely full and was still available for walk in. After about 2 - 3 mins after being seated, we were immediately approached by a staff that took our order. Depsite us being not ready to order yet, she patiently guided as through and answered our questions.

The Yangzhou fried rice was nice, though nothing out of the ordinary, just well made fried rice. The century egg spinach (not in picture) was nice, and was really flavourful. The century egg was nice too, and the quantity was good. We ordered the chilli crab (mud crab) and mantou. The crab was really soft, and the chilli sauce was really delicious and flavourful, without being too spicy.

Overall, the food is really delicious. To ensure that you can taste the other dishes, definitely try to consume the weaker tasting foods before eating the stronger tasting ones (e.g. chilli crab). Price is on the high end, but i suppose once in a while it's ok.

author: Francis Leung
review_text: We had a great time at Jumbo Seafood Riverside, Singapore.  The private room we got came with a really nice view, which made the whole experience even better.  The food was, as always, consistently good.  The bamboo clam was huge and absolutely delicious, definitely at a highlight.  And of course, the famous chilli crab didn’t disappoint - we had a 1.6 kg one, and it was really, really good.  Overall, a solid dining experience with great food and atmosphere.

author: NAPAL PROMPONG
review_text:
This is a wonderful restaurant in Singapore. The highlight is definitely the Crab dishes. The meat is sweet and the sauce is perfect.

I am Thai, and I am usually picky about Thai food abroad, but the Tom Yum here is fantastic. It tastes like the original flavor from home.
Even though the bill was a bit high, I feel it is totally worth it. The experience and the high quality of ingredients make it great value. If you want a delicious seafood meal, you should come here.

author: lay hwa chong
review_text:
The service staff were excellent - both at East Coast and Riverwalk branches. Polite, knowledgeable and sharp to observe your needs!

The Chinese spinach was pathetic- especially the salted egg cubes which tasted like artificial gum, the century egg is too hard, not “oily” enough.

The chilli crab served to its expected standard- I was there 3 weeks ago and the taste is consistent.

I was disappointed that I could not use my Dec birthday discount because the Alaskan crab was already discounted and even though we clocked $552.14 in total bill, we could not reach the required $200 after taking out the Alaskan crab. There was only 2 of us.
Can you consider extending the voucher till end Jan as an exception? I would have love to use it but I’ll be travelling 22 Dec, returning 23 Jan.
Thank you

author: C G
review_text: Haven’t been to Jumbo for several years. We were craving for chilli crabs so Jumbo was our top choice. The chilli crabs were so fresh and sweet. However, they were less spicy than before, we reckoned the outlet caters more to tourists (who might not be able to take spicy dishes). We requested “more spicy” for its Mee Goreng - turned out really good as the squids and prawns were so fresh. As for the stir-fried asparagus with XO sauce, it was flavourful but could have been better if they used the medium-sized ones or fried or steamed them abit longer. Overall, we had a nice meal, and the next time, we will ask for our crabs to be “more spicy”.

author: Lee
review_text:
ChiliCrab is a dish, which, can be found throughout Singapore, but I’m told it’s not always prepared the same everywhere. So, after searching, I came across this place and the reviews were impressive.

I ordered the Chili Crab, Prawns and the soup. The crab was absolutely delicious. It was fresh and extremely flavorful and had lots of crab meat. The prawns were lightly batted and had good flavor as did the soup.

The restaurant is large and offers both indoor and outdoor seating. It sits directly off the water where boats and other water craft travel by showcasing their unique and colorful lighting displays. The staff were friendly and even suggested a few popular dishes.

I do recommend making  reservations. This is a popular place for tourists to dine and it can get very busy.

author: Morgan Williams
review_text: My first time having crab and it was awesome! Got a black pepper mud crab and enjoyed the messiness, the cracking and slurping and of course it was delicious. It's a busy spot so you might have to wait for a short time for a table but totally worth it. The couple sides were salted egg prawns and Fried rice, both were fantastic, probably the best I've had. Staff were great, service was fast and the place had a humming vibe. Loved it.

author: Jason Nah
review_text:
4th Oct .
Just have another great session w my friends . Bcos of a special event, managed to get help from jumbo Desmond & Mary to coordinate the event. All special thanks to them & those waitresses & waiters that serving us on that day.
As for the food, tried many other dishes besides their famous chilli crab, beef, herbal prawn, fresh fish. All are delicious. Taste standard always there.. Will come again soon.
👍👍👍👍
————————————————————————/
30th Sept
Have great dinner with my overseas guests  in Jumbo riverwalk with the delicious crab, beef as well as other gd dishes.. Many thanks to Desmond as well as other waiters that served us well & very attentive & fast in attending our request.

author: Darion Mannie
review_text: Breathtaking and beautiful, this gem combines niche ambience with salivating soul-food. The meals were delicious! While the chilli-crab is the star, the supporting cast were spectacular - bringing everything together in lip-smacking goodness. Service could be slightly better in terms of explaining how to enjoy the experience, and pacing the food delivery - but I guess there is no time for niceties with the amount of table churn! Highly recommend, definitely book a table as close to the riverwalk as possible, don a bib, slip on the gloves and start slurping!

author: Todd J
review_text: Jumbo was recommended by a long time Singaporean. The service was top notch each person on the waitstaff was very attentive to your needs. We had the Chili Alaskan King Crab and the Alaskan king crab in egg whites and wine. I would highly recommend both. The only issue we had was with ordering, you need to be very specific on the weight you would like for your crab choice. We said we wanted one crab with chile and one crab with the other sauce. What we ended up with was 2.8 Kg of crab ! Wish the waitstaff made it more clear but that was on us for not asking or being specific. Overall great place to try at least once !

author: Roberto Soriano Doménech
review_text:
It was a super nice experince. The chili crab is a must and it deserves the price. We tryed to eat all the dish but was too much. It was tasty, the right touch of chilli. We also order broccoli with saint jacques, wine and two mangoes, one chilli and the other with rice.

Everything with a perfect service from Tammy

author: SEYEON OH (Vanessa)
review_text: Perfect! Atmosphere, mode was good. There are a lot of people and we had reservation but bit late because of the traffic but the restaurant keep the reservation for us. So nice people and delicious food. Recommend the chilli crab with rice and peeled cereal shrimp :9

author: Amy Booth
review_text: Walked in at noon on a Friday and was seated immediately. They give you 1.5 hours to dine in which was plenty of time. The food was amazing and the service was quick! The servers made sure to explain each dish I ordered so I knew exactly what I was getting. We got the shelled prawns fried with golden salted egg (not pictured), cod fish with spicy sauce, chili mud crab, and cereal prawns. Cereal prawns and salted egg prawns were similar. Cod fish was a favorite! Would recommend any of these dishes!

author: Ruby Chen
review_text: We had the set menu for two at Jumbo Seafood, and it was fantastic! The crabs were fresh and perfectly seasoned. The portion sizes were generous, and the set allowed us to try a variety of dishes, all of which were delicious. A great dining experience from start to finish!

author: YipeeKaYay
review_text:
Food: 3  service: 5.  Atmosphere: 4

Came here for their specialty dishes: crab in chili, black pepper crab and cereal prawns.  Also ordered the scallops (came late, hands already filled with crab sauce, not photographed) and kangkong.

Strong AC indoor and beautiful seating outside on the water edge

author: Iris Isabelle
review_text: Our server Antonio was very nice and served us well! The good as always was great. The 50% off promo for Alaskan King Crab is always worth it.

author: Calvin Tan
review_text:
Had an incredible evening hosting a family birthday event in VIP room 4 on 11 Aug 2025. Thank you Jumbo Riverwalk for the impeccable and thoughtful service.

Special thanks to Zhang Mingyu and her crew for the memorable experience provided. Kudos for the signature Jumbo delights for satisfying our tummies too!

author: David Tom
review_text: Their chilli crab was delicious. Location was great, and the service was really good. Just know there's a time limit to finish your meal, and the cost will be higher due to it's location and popularity.

author: fanny cheung
review_text:
The chili grab is never disappointed!
We ordered other seafood such as razor clams, prawns and steamed cod fish.  The fish was a big surprise, as they put egg white at the bottom and it’s just the best we have ever had.

author: Don Banchit
review_text: We hadn't booked but stopped by to check and luckily we were able to get a table.  We ordered the singapore chilli crab, Fried goby fish, salted egg prawns, and seafood rice. The food was amazing as expected, you won't be disappointed.

author: Mackaz Sajiaos Tan
review_text: I recently dined at this seafood restaurant by the river, and it was a wonderful experience from start to finish. The service was genuinely great—friendly, attentive, and welcoming. Their dim sum is definitely my favorite; fresh, flavorful, and easily the highlight of the meal. The river view added a relaxing and scenic backdrop, making the whole visit feel extra special. It’s a perfect spot for gatherings with family or friends. Highly recommend!

author: Francis Luna
review_text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ great evening by the river. Such a lovely spot for dinner in Singapore! The atmosphere is relaxing and the seafood is delicious. What really stood out was the service; Lennie Anne took such good care of our table. She was very helpful and ensured we had everything we needed. We will definitely be back.

author: Michael Hui
review_text:
We visited this restaurant last night as a group of 5 and had a fantastic dining experience. We ordered their famous Chili King Crab — absolutely delicious, though expensive as expected for king crab. The staff even let us take photos with the live crab before cooking, which was a fun and memorable touch.

We also enjoyed the steamed mussels, cereal prawns, and Peking roasted duck — all were well-prepared and tasted great. Dining by the sea front made the experience even better, with a beautiful view and relaxing atmosphere. The staff were responsive, friendly, and helpful throughout the meal. A great place for a special seafood dinner with a view!

author: Imelda Luna
review_text: This is the nth time we have dined here already. Along with the other diners, while we usually flock here for their chili crab, the lobster thermidore we have ordered was actually a hidden gem and a must try! Incredibly fresh and sweet meat. Thank you for the great meal. Lennie was also very helpful and friendly, thank you. We always wanted to come back. Very kind and all smiles. We had a great time..

author: Karen Chia
review_text:
Went for their lunch sets which is a good deal for working people around the area.

Almost full house when we reached. Lucky there was still table for 2 persons.

Quickly settled down and ordered our food. Food portions were big and value for money. Staff were helpful and accommodating as my friend was on a strict diet.

We were very pleased with their lunch sets and would love to go back to try their other value sets.

author: Ellerie Luna
review_text: Singapore Chili Alaskan King Crab, the signature dish of Seafood by the River, is an absolute showstopper and a must-order for anyone visiting Boat Quay! We were greeted and accommodated by Lennie very nicely. Perfect dinner for our family. Very recommended and we will definitely be back! ❤️🧡

author: Hillary
review_text:
